text: No CI: every check runs locally, the NEON paths on an aarch64 machine and Miri before a release (rule ci.contributors-only)
why: The user chose (2026-11-01), under baseline 2026.10.11's ci.contributors-only (a project not open to contributions has no workflows and GitHub Actions off; CI only for a check no machine here can run): ci.yml, deny.yml and notices.yml are gone. The previous choice kept ci.yml's arm and Miri jobs on the premise that no machine here could run them, which was wrong: vgmacbook is aarch64 (Apple Silicon, on the tailnet) and runs the NEON tests, and Miri runs on Windows with a nightly toolchain. Before every commit: the README's Tests and benchmarks list (tests on the host, no-std and wasm builds, the lean build, clippy with every feature, rustdoc, cargo deny, tend check), the Python bindings and flux's backends when they change. Before a release: the NEON tests and clippy on aarch64, and Miri over the unsafe views (both in the README). Plugin notices: `cargo xtask notices` before building a plugin release. Dependabot keeps opening cargo update pull requests (its github-actions updates went with the workflows); they're checked locally before merging. Answers vg-paradigms' graft 01a19343 (CI by hand), which the rule went past.
